full_inspection: Compared all four native images completely, including the full footnote, formula spacing, uncertain first word, small point beside N and blue correction marks. Enlarged paired crops confirm the n deletion and shared comma spacing. All visible handwriting is recorded below.

Copy2 adds the n deletion, hooked sign and its own archive number; its space before the M1,2 comma reflects spacing actually shared by both scans. Both original transcriptions silently read the first word as modulaires, now explicitly doubtful.
